goal: Linux x86-64 Windows functional parity, reusing the shared Windows/macOS core; Ubuntu 24.04 Wayland and X11 qualification; ARM64-ready boundaries without ARM64 delivery
completion_policy: Every required row needs exact packaged-artifact end-to-end evidence, or an explicitly accepted platform exception. Build/unit checks are gates, never application testing. Missing devices remain unqualified. No row is waived by an early milestone.
